units: metres; game space: x right (blue -x west, red +x east), y up, z south (north = -z). rect = [x0, z0, x1, z1]; circle = [cx, cz, r]; points [x, y, z] or [x, y, z, lookYaw] (lookYaw = atan2(dx, dz))
mirror: symmetric across x = 0: items with side "blue"/"red" are mirror copies; centre items have no side

tdm.label: Team Deathmatch 4v4 .. 6v6
tdm.rule: pick the spawn point in your yard with the most distance to visible/heard enemies (3 clusters N / mid / S); never spawn in sight of an enemy within 25 m; no forward spawns (yards are walled + thick)
tdm.size_note: 4v4: whole map (lanes are connected every 10-16 m so it never feels empty). 5v5-6v6: same map, best size. 2v2-3v3: optional "small" variant closes the back road + book heights with paper barricades.

ffa.label: Free for all (up to 10)
ffa.rule: pick the free spawn farthest from all players (min 14 m and not in view)

dom.label: Domination (3 flags)

flags.where: Coffee Stain Plaza (north of the cup, mouth of Bridge Street, under the bunting)

dom.rule: capture 8 s, 1 point / s per flag; when a team holds 3 flags or its home flag is taken, spawns flip to the opposite clusters only if those are safe (CoD rule)

bomb.label: Search & Destroy / Demolition (2 sites)
bomb.note: sites are on the DEFENDERS half; at half-time teams swap ends and the sites mirror (map is symmetric, both halves are built as sites)

ctf.label: Capture the Flag

flags.where: inside the Blue Pencil-Case HQ (3 doors: east mouth, north, south)

ctf.rule: carrier cannot sprint or throw planes; dropped flag returns after 20 s; capture only with your flag at home; respawn 6 s; first to 3

hide_and_fold.label: Hide & Fold (prop hunt)
hide_and_fold.rule: hiders start in the middle and get 30 s to fold into a prop; seekers wait inside both Pencil-Case HQs (doors closed, screen dark) then hunt from both ends; round 4 min; hiders crinkle every 20 s; seekers lose 5 HP per wrong-prop shot
